svg.title: The requests of Agent Chat UI for one approval
svg.desc: Three lifelines: the Agent Chat UI in the browser, Agent Server under langgraph dev, and the agent graph on Ollama. Step 1, on load the UI calls GET /info and POST /threads/search with graph_id agent and limit 100, and the first message of a thread calls POST /threads. Step 2, the message is POST runs/stream with stream modes values, messages-tuple, custom and on_disconnect continue. The model returns the whole send_email call 15.20 s after the POST, a messages event carries it, and a values event carries __interrupt__. The UI then calls POST /history. Step 3, Approve sends POST runs/stream with command.resume decisions approve, on_disconnect cancel, and stream_resumable false. The tool runs, the first token arrives 2.72 s after the POST, and the UI paints it 0.09 s later.

g.text: on load and after each connect
first message of a thread only
3 values and 2 messages events in all
first token 2.72 s, painted 0.09 s later
